objective: Localize why the learned Semantic ENS8 loses positive-regret signal on protected CFR holdout states where the stored CFR target is decisive enough to avoid fallback.

population.primary: protected holdout states where A_CURRENT_RAW_MEAN_RM enters SOFTMAX_FALLBACK and stored CFR target has at least one positive legal Advantage
population.secondary: all protected holdout states for baseline comparison

frozen_metrics: target best-action positive Advantage magnitude distribution
count distribution of members predicting target-best raw >0
fraction where every member individually falls back
fraction where at least one member has positive legal regret but raw-mean cancels to global fallback
mean-raw bias and absolute error on target-best action
member-policy-mean probability assigned to CFR target-best action
diagnostic by target-strength quartile and decile
diagnostic by number of legal actions

classifications.ALL_MEMBERS_LOSE_SIGNAL: Most target-positive current-fallback states have zero members preserving positive sign on the CFR-best action and/or most members individually fallback.
classifications.ENSEMBLE_CANCELLATION_DOMINANT: Most target-positive current-fallback states retain positive target-best sign in multiple members but arithmetic raw averaging cancels all legal positives.
classifications.MIXED_MODEL_AND_ENSEMBLE_FAILURE: Neither all-member loss nor cancellation alone dominates.
classifications.TARGET_MARGIN_FRAGILE: Sign loss is concentrated overwhelmingly in the weakest target-positive magnitude quantiles.

decision_rules.all_members_lose_signal_if: fraction with zero members positive on CFR-best action >=0.50 OR mean fraction of individually-fallback members >=0.75
decision_rules.ensemble_cancellation_if: fraction with >=4 members positive on CFR-best action >=0.50 while current raw mean globally falls back
decision_rules.target_margin_fragile_if: at least 80% of target-positive fallback states lie in bottom two quartiles of target max-positive Advantage magnitude relative to all target-positive holdout states
